Some lines were not recognised. I compared the PDF with this preview; any missing income must be added manually before filing.
An earlier month has unresolved income or FX. Resolve it first: the cumulative total and tax rate may change.
I use ordinary SBS (not VAT or a special regime). All income relevant to this year’s calculation is accounted for, including other accounts and cash. Transfers and fees are checked.
Recorded income exceeds GEL 100,000. Check VAT registration requirements now.
Recorded income is approaching GEL 100,000. Check which services count towards the VAT threshold before your next payment.
Your next-month scenario approaches GEL 100,000. Check VAT applicability in advance.
This scenario exceeds GEL 100,000 next month.
Partial total: %1$d entries need review or an exchange rate. Forecast and remaining amount are unavailable.
Based only on recorded included income, not confirmed VAT-taxable turnover. Missing income and foreign-client services need separate review.
Automatic forecast unavailable: six completed months with income entries and resolved data are required. You can enter your own estimate.
The initial estimate is the median of the last six completed monthly totals. You can change it.
Scenario = known 12-month total − outgoing month + expected income. Assumes no further income this month. This is not a guaranteed forecast or an assessment of past VAT obligations.

Article 165: the general registration threshold is more than GEL 100,000 of qualifying turnover in any consecutive 12 calendar months; apply within 2 business days of crossing it. GEL 90,000 is an early warning, not a registration threshold.
